# Activity

> Shared static and collapsible activity anatomy with bounded, scrollable detail content.

This file matches the installed `activity` source. The online docs follow the latest release and may describe a newer version.

## Install

```bash
npx shadcn@latest add https://control-ui.dev/r/activity.json
```

With `@ctrl-ui/react` instead of the registry, import from `@ctrl-ui/react/` where this file says `@/components/control-ui/`; this file then lives at `node_modules/@ctrl-ui/react/dist/docs/activity.md`.

## npm dependencies

- `lucide-react@^1.47.0`

## Registry dependencies

- `collapsible`
- `core`
- `effects`
- `live-status`
- `scroll-area`
- `swap`

## Exports

- `@/components/control-ui/knob-contracts/activity-knobs`: `activityKnobs`, types `ActivityKnobStyle`
- `@/components/control-ui/activity`: `Activity`, `ActivityRow`, `ActivityTrigger`, `ActivityIcon`, `ActivityTitle`, `ActivityStatus`, `ActivityContent`, `ActivityDetail`, `ActivityDetailLabel`, `ActivityDetailContent`, types `ActivityState`, `ActivityKind`, `ActivityDetailFormat`, `ActivityProps`, `ActivityRowProps`, `ActivityTriggerProps`, `ActivityIconProps`, `ActivityTitleProps`, `ActivityStatusProps`, `ActivityContentProps`, `ActivityDetailProps`, `ActivityDetailLabelProps`, `ActivityDetailTone`, `ActivityDetailContentProps`

## Composition

### Static activity

```tsx
<Activity>
  <ActivityRow>
    <ActivityIcon />
    <ActivityTitle />
    <ActivityStatus />
  </ActivityRow>
</Activity>
```

### Collapsible activity

```tsx
<Activity>
  <ActivityTrigger>
    <ActivityIcon />
    <ActivityTitle />
    <ActivityStatus />
  </ActivityTrigger>
  <ActivityContent>
    <Timeline />
    <SourceBadge />
    <ActivityDetail>
      <ActivityDetailLabel />
      <ActivityDetailContent />
    </ActivityDetail>
  </ActivityContent>
</Activity>
```

## Usage

```tsx
"use client";

import { BookOpen, Globe, Radio, Search, SquareTerminal } from "lucide-react";

import type { ReactNode } from "react";
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";

import {
  Activity,
  ActivityContent,
  ActivityDetail,
  ActivityDetailContent,
  ActivityDetailLabel,
  ActivityIcon,
  ActivityRow,
  ActivityStatus,
  ActivityTitle,
  ActivityTrigger,
} from "@/components/control-ui/activity";
import { SourceBadge } from "@/components/control-ui/source-badge";
import { Spinner } from "@/components/control-ui/ui/spinner";
import type { TimelineState } from "@/components/control-ui/ui/timeline";
import {
  Timeline,
  TimelineContent,
  TimelineIndicator,
  TimelineItem,
  TimelineSeparator,
  TimelineTitle,
} from "@/components/control-ui/ui/timeline";
import { Text } from "@/components/control-ui/ui/typography";

const thinkingTrace = [
  { icon: <SquareTerminal />, label: "Ran the registry validation command", state: "success" },
  { icon: <Search />, label: "Searched for the current skin slot contract", state: "success" },
  { icon: <BookOpen />, label: "Read activity.tsx", state: "success" },
  { icon: <BookOpen />, label: "Read chat-layout.tsx", state: "success" },
  { icon: <Search />, label: "Compared disclosure behavior across agent surfaces", state: "success" },
  { icon: <Globe />, label: "Searched the web for Base UI accessibility guidance", state: "success" },
  { icon: <Spinner />, label: "Reading the ScrollArea overflow contract", state: "running" },
  { icon: <SquareTerminal />, label: "Run the focused render tests", state: "pending" },
] satisfies Array<{ icon: ReactNode; label: string; state: TimelineState }>;

const runSteps = [
  "Reading activity.tsx",
  "Searching the registry for disclosure patterns",
  "Editing chat-layout.tsx",
  "Running the render tests",
];

function LiveRunActivity() {
  const [step, setStep] = useState(0);

  useEffect(() => {
    const timer = window.setInterval(() => setStep((current) => (current + 1) % runSteps.length), 1800);
    return () => window.clearInterval(timer);
  }, []);

  return (
    <Activity kind="tool" state="running">
      <ActivityRow>
        <ActivityIcon />
        <ActivityTitle>{runSteps[step]}</ActivityTitle>
      </ActivityRow>
    </Activity>
  );
}

export function ActivityExample() {
  return (
    <div className="mx-auto grid w-full max-w-xl gap-5">
      <Activity state="success">
        <ActivityRow>
          <ActivityIcon>
            <Search />
          </ActivityIcon>
          <ActivityTitle>Read files, searched the web</ActivityTitle>
        </ActivityRow>
      </Activity>

      <Activity kind="signal" state="success">
        <ActivityRow>
          <ActivityIcon>
            <Radio />
          </ActivityIcon>
          <ActivityTitle>CI signal — build failed on PR #42</ActivityTitle>
          <ActivityStatus>Delivered</ActivityStatus>
        </ActivityRow>
      </Activity>

      <LiveRunActivity />

      <Activity kind="reasoning" state="running" defaultOpen>
        <ActivityTrigger>
          <ActivityIcon>
            <BookOpen />
          </ActivityIcon>
          <ActivityTitle>Thinking</ActivityTitle>
        </ActivityTrigger>
        <ActivityContent maxHeight="12rem">
          <Timeline>
            {thinkingTrace.map((item) => (
              <TimelineItem key={item.label} state={item.state}>
                <TimelineIndicator>{item.icon}</TimelineIndicator>
                <TimelineSeparator />
                <TimelineContent>
                  <TimelineTitle>{item.label}</TimelineTitle>
                </TimelineContent>
              </TimelineItem>
            ))}
          </Timeline>
        </ActivityContent>
      </Activity>

      <Activity state="success" defaultOpen>
        <ActivityTrigger>
          <ActivityIcon>
            <Search />
          </ActivityIcon>
          <ActivityTitle>Searched the web for Base UI disclosure patterns</ActivityTitle>
        </ActivityTrigger>
        <ActivityContent>
          <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1.5">
            <SourceBadge href="https://ui.shadcn.com/docs/components/base/marker" faviconSrc="https://ui.shadcn.com/favicon.ico">
              shadcn/ui
            </SourceBadge>
            <SourceBadge href="https://base-ui.com/react/components/collapsible" faviconSrc="https://base-ui.com/favicon.ico">
              Base UI
            </SourceBadge>
            <SourceBadge href="https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/Accessibility" faviconSrc="/missing-favicon.ico">
              MDN
            </SourceBadge>
          </div>
          <Text as="p" size="label" tone="muted">
            The shared activity anatomy owns disclosure and overflow. Source links stay inside the expanded content, never inside its
            button.
          </Text>
        </ActivityContent>
      </Activity>

      <Activity kind="tool" name="read_registry" state="success" defaultOpen>
        <ActivityTrigger>
          <ActivityIcon>
            <BookOpen />
          </ActivityIcon>
          <ActivityTitle>Read registry files</ActivityTitle>
        </ActivityTrigger>
        <ActivityContent>
          <ActivityDetail>
            <ActivityDetailLabel>Input</ActivityDetailLabel>
            <ActivityDetailContent format="code">{`{ "path": "chat.json" }`}</ActivityDetailContent>
          </ActivityDetail>
          <ActivityDetail>
            <ActivityDetailLabel>Output</ActivityDetailLabel>
            <ActivityDetailContent>Loaded the registry definition.</ActivityDetailContent>
          </ActivityDetail>
        </ActivityContent>
      </Activity>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## Anatomy

Scopes, their parts, and the state attributes each part carries. Selector pattern: `[data-skin="{skin}"] :where([data-slot="{part}"][data-control-family="{family}"])`.

- `activity`
  - `chevron`: `data-icon-dir` (`inline`)
  - `content`
  - `content-grid`
  - `detail`
  - `detail-content`: `data-format` (`code` | `text`), `data-tone` (`danger` | `neutral`)
  - `detail-label`
  - `icon`: `data-status-icon`
  - `root`: `data-activity-kind` (`default` | `reasoning` | `signal` | `tool`), `data-activity-name` (any value), `data-activity-state` (`error` | `pending` | `running` | `success` | `waiting`)
  - `row`
  - `status`: `data-kind` (`default` | `reasoning` | `signal` | `tool`), `data-status` (`error` | `pending` | `running` | `success` | `waiting`)
  - `title`
  - `trigger`

## Knobs

Registered `--cui-*` custom properties with their recipe defaults. Set them through the component's `style` prop or a skin.

### activity

- `--cui-activity-row-foreground`: `var(--muted-foreground)`
- `--cui-activity-trigger-radius`: `var(--radius-control)`
- `--cui-activity-trigger-hover-background`: `var(--hover-fill)`
- `--cui-activity-code-background`: `oklch(from var(--muted) l c h / 0.5)`
- `--cui-activity-code-radius`: `var(--radius-control)`
